title: App Studio 改版（3-1）：数据集归到「数据」组并放常用，岗位放常用——注册表 domain ui→data、菜单点名放置、ADR-0084 表格同步
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbL6Nn3scsU8yvLyU4

Filing gate: ③ · Source: `docs/adr/0084` on main, `#amendment-2026-11-26-moves`: dataset and position are placed in 常用 by name (question 4, ruled yes; record 7187264388 on #37451). On 2026-11-26 at 13:25Z the maintainer asked to bring phase 3 forward (「这些很简单吧？」). Sub-issue of #37424 (phase 3).
Grade: area:ux · Feature · p2 · evidence: `packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts:977` registers `dataset` with `domain: 'ui'`. `studioMenuPlacement.ts` already carries the 常用 / 高级 tiers (ruling on #37192).
Reader: area `ux-37424`.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：Studio 菜单里的「数据集」从「界面」组挪到「数据」组，紧跟在对象后面，并且常驻显示。「岗位」在「访问」组里常驻显示。
- 为什么：数据集是图表和 AI 问数共用的语义层，属于数据。
- 注意：要改 spec 注册表，需要合约审查。ADR-0084 的菜单表有测试盯着，必须在同一个 PR 里一起改，所以走 Tier H 审批。
- 需要你做的：这个 Tier H PR 由你合并。

## What

- `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY`: change `dataset` from `domain: 'ui'` to `'data'`. Update every consumer of the domain: group labels, directory grouping, the menu model. This is a spec contract change, so L2 runs at the contract tier.
- `studioMenuPlacement.ts`:
  - `dataset` goes in 常用, directly after `object`.
  - `position` goes in 常用, directly after `permission`.
  - Both are placements by name, each with its reason in a comment: dataset's schema requires one object; position is one slot per environment (ADR-0150 D7).
- `docs/adr/0084`: rewrite the type→group table rows in the same PR. `studioMenuPlacement.test.ts` scans every ADR line of that row shape and pins it to the registry and the placement list, so never add a second table of that shape. Carry N8 in the same edit (#37424 comment 7189717418): link the 2026-11-24 note's mark to `#amendment-2026-11-26-position`.
- `form` (ADR-0159, #37086) is not registered yet. If it lands first, its row follows the amendment: 常用, 界面 UI, after `report`.

## Acceptance

- The menu draws dataset under 数据 right after 对象, and position under 访问 right after 权限集, both outside the 高级 fold. Screenshots in light and dark.
- The pin test is green with the rewritten rows, and a spec test covers the registry domain change.
- Sequencing: #37454 (PR #37546) also edits `studioMenuModel.ts`. Merge main after it lands.
